Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a bathroom remodel take?

A typical full bathroom renovation takes 1–3 weeks depending on scope. A simple tile and fixture swap is faster; a full gut with custom tile and plumbing relocation takes longer. We'll give you a specific timeline in your written estimate before any work starts.

How long does a kitchen remodel take?

Most kitchen remodels run 3–6 weeks. Ordering lead times on cabinets and countertops are usually the longest factor — we account for those in the schedule before we pull permits or start demolition.

Do you handle permits?

Yes. We pull all required permits as part of the job. This protects you when you sell the home and ensures inspections are done correctly. We don't skip permits to save time — and you shouldn't want a contractor who does.

Can I use the bathroom or kitchen during the remodel?

For kitchens, we set up a temporary prep station so you're not completely without a workspace. For bathrooms, if you have a second one, the timing is manageable. We'll walk through logistics with you before work begins.

Do you provide a warranty?

Yes — all labor is warranted for one year. Manufacturer warranties on tile, fixtures, and cabinetry are passed through to you. We'll walk you through everything at project completion.
